title: fix(ui): run WebKit overlay contracts without expected failures
body:
## What Problem This Solves

The WebKit overlay/composer gate carried twelve expected failures, obscuring whether its contracts were useful for the Solid migration.

## User Impact

No product or visual behavior changes. WebKit now runs all 293 selected assertions without expected-failure exceptions; the existing assertions remain in force.

## Why This Change Was Made

All twelve failures were fixture artifacts:

| Cases | Cause and repair |
| --- | --- |
| Modal native occlusion (1) | A module mock did not reach components already imported by sibling browser suites. Seed the real native bridge boundary instead. |
| Modal opening focus (4) | Synthetic input ran inside showModal before WebKit made slotted content usable. Inject input at the opening commit, then verify it survives later animation work. |
| Tooltip skin (1) | Native adopted stylesheets have no style elements; WebKit also serializes the animation shorthand differently. Inspect adopted rules and assert the animation-name longhand. |
| Goal Shift-Tab (3) | Pointer activation and keyboard traversal were combined in one sequence. Exercise native keyboard order before the pointer pass; use Option-Tab on macOS WebKit, where default Safari settings exclude buttons from plain Tab. Preserve all focus, action, and geometry assertions. |
| Effort appearance (3) | The fixture read hidden popup styles before the queued details toggle activated it. Await that existing transition before inspecting appearance. |

The expected-failure registry, setup, reporter, and obsolete CI selector are removed. The mock baseline shrinks by one exact entry. A separately reproduced tooltip fake-clock race now waits for the commit that arms its hover timer before advancing time.

Release-note context: internal Control UI test reliability only; no dependency or browser-floor change.

## Evidence

Final head: 08dce52ae4948af41691dd52421dbda00c17f9bd. The import conflict with current main was resolved by retaining its Solid plugin and TSX discovery while removing the obsolete expected-failure import.

Testbox through `node scripts/crabbox-wrapper.mjs`, Linux/Node 24.19.0, Playwright 1.63.0:

- Final lease `tbx_01m4jp2feamv9wg018g0bfgg5k`, [run 38045397729](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38045397729): full WebKit 293/293, Chromium 23/23, UI typecheck, targeted UI/config lint and formatting passed. Earlier lease `tbx_01m4jkw6a0w9ptrq8md987gr96`, [run 38043163769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38043163769), supplied the individual contract timings, script/test lint and stylelint. The first lease reached its workflow lifetime; all leases are stopped at handoff.
- `OPENCLAW_UI_WEBKIT=1 pnpm --dir ui test --project=webkit --maxWorkers=3 --reporter=dot`: 16.90 s Vitest / 17.97 s shell wall.
- Chromium composer overflow + effort suites: 23/23, 4.99 s Vitest / 6.06 s shell wall. Current-head UI typecheck: 42.51 s.
- Earlier lease `tbx_01m4jg2thvfna2p38rmqj7n0y0`, [run 38039261335](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38039261335): jsdom modal + tooltip 74/74; CI selection 9/9; core-test, UI, and root-test typechecks, ratchets, formatting, and i18n passed.
- Codex autoreview: no actionable P0–P2 findings.

Individual cost measurements use `OPENCLAW_UI_WEBKIT=1 pnpm --dir ui test --project=webkit --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot <file>` at a573039 (before the compiler-wiring merge; test sources are unchanged):

| File | Tests | Vitest seconds | Testbox shell wall seconds |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| src/components/modal-dialog.test.ts | 25 | 1.93 | 2.51 |
| src/components/tooltip.test.ts | 49 | 1.32 | 1.92 |
| src/pages/chat/chat-composer-overflow.browser.test.ts | 19 | 4.20 | 4.83 |
| src/pages/chat/components/chat-effort-picker.browser.test.ts | 4 | 0.53 | 1.11 |

Known broader-proof gaps:

- The full Chromium run passed 1,446/1,447. The unchanged markdown-file-tooltip case timed out awaiting “Copied!”. Its standalone reproduction passed 13/13; this is recorded as an unresolved intermittent failure, not a claimed fix.
- On the earlier base, full `check:changed` stopped at pre-existing unused exports: `isPollVoteEchoText`, `PUBLIC_SESSION_ENTRY_SCRIPT`, and `isClaudeLikeLiveAgent`. Their files are unchanged. All preceding checks passed; the remaining touched lint/style checks were run directly and passed.
- Playwright WebKit proof is not exact-floor macOS WKWebView qualification. No screenshot is required because production markup/styles are unchanged.
